url.title: Endpoint URL
url.description: The Gemini OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint.

api_key.title: API Key
api_key.description: Your Google AI Studio API key.

is_stream.title: Enable streaming
is_stream.description: Enables data streaming when supported by the model. When true, responses are processed in chunks for immediate delivery. Default is false.

timeout.title: HTTP Timeout
timeout.description: The maximum time, in seconds, to wait for a response from the server before the request is canceled.

request_format.title: Request Format
request_format.default: {"model":"gemini-2.0-flash", "messages":[{"role": "user", "content": "What do you know about APIs?"}], "stream": false}

response_format.title: Response Format
response_format.default: {"choices":[{"index": 0, "message":{"role": "assistant", "content": "APIs let software applications communicate with each other."}, "finish_reason": "stop"}]}
